lina: Ok team — I'm originating an RC for the model-server rollout we discussed. Artifact: `model-server:v4.2.1-rc3` (sha256:abc123def456). Target promo window 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC. Need QA + ops signoff and a sheriff for the window.

matt: Ack. Can we pin the candidate and run KV warm job before canary?

deploy-bot: RC created: `rc-20260320-3` -> pinned to `model-server:v4.2.1-rc3`.
Canary schedule: 18:05 UTC -> 10% for 5m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%.
Commands: `/deploybot status rc-20260320-3` and `/deploybot promote rc-20260320-3`

elaine: QA smoke run started on `rc-20260320-3` in staging. Running simple latency/throughput checks. I'll post results in 10m.

jen: Ops note: KV warm job queued. We'll pre-warm prefix cache and cold-start pool at 17:55 UTC. I set `autoscale.min=3` for the candidate during promotion.

ryan: I can sheriff the window. I'll be on standby 17:45-19:00 UTC. Add my pager.

lina: Thanks. Rollback plan: immediate rollback to `model-server:v4.2.0` if error rate >2% sustained over 5m or latency p99 regresses by >200ms after promotion. We will use the deploy-bot automated rollback unless someone manually overrides.

matt: Agreed. Also pin DB migration flag off for this RC, no schema changes. Release notes: add the small embedding fix and perf tweaks.

elaine: Smoke results: all green except embedding median latency +12ms (in range). No functional regressions. Logs snippet: ```
[smoke] requests: 5000
[smoke] errors: 0
[smoke] p95: 120ms
```

lina: Great. If no objections by 17:50 UTC I'll trigger `/deploybot prepare rc-20260320-3` then warming.

deploy-bot: `/deploybot prepare rc-20260320-3` acknowledged. KV warm at 17:55 scheduled. Canary will start at 18:05 UTC. Auto-rollback thresholds set: error_rate>2% (5m) OR p99_delta>200ms.

matt: :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary metrics and be ready to cut traffic back.

jen: Ops checklist attached to RC: warming done, infra autoscale checked, KMS validations ok.

lina: Sheriff @ryan confirmed. QA @elaine green. Ops @jen done. Last call for objections — none?

ryan: No objections from me.

lina: /promote scheduled at 18:05 UTC. I'll initiate unless anyone posts within 15m.

deploy-bot: Noted. Will post status updates during canary and alert on thresholds. :rocket:
